counts.poi_margin_rule: no props except explicitly derived low A8 shell-edge tufts/stones outside core/door/approach

rules.a8_shell_edges: public 128x128 transform derives low exterior tufts/stones only; canonical, approach, retreat, road, spawn, resource and doorway-clear cells remain empty
rules.ground: runtime source surface/biome mapping on every non-curated rendered cell; 11 curated windows remain authoritative benchmarks
rules.meso: road margins, source junctions, blocked forest/stone mass, resource/POI/spawn clearances and explicit Quarry/Orchard clusters
rules.micro: low ground cover and stone on eligible walkable cells; tall scenery only on off-route cells outside spawn/POI/resource clearances; visual-only with no collision/build data; one micro prop per 4x4 sector
rules.randomization: stable hash ranking inside causal eligible clusters only; no per-chunk uniform decoration fill
